product_definition: FP4*E4M3/256,127 finite magnitude codes x2 scale signs x16 FP4 codes

A.scope: Uniform affine bias/scale on a bit-permuted three-bit magnitude with a copied sign. Does not exclude multi-piece arithmetic or every possible floating decoder.
A.decision: No exact uniform-bias form found. The existing zero-bias tiny-BF16 multiply is the matching form;all4064-product exactness does not provide a cheaper extraction.

B.scope: Direct constant-index zero-shift extraction to the existing tiny-BF16 register layout using constant-index byte permutations/bit selections and no widened weight storage;not a lower bound for every decoder.
B.decision: Requested direct one-LOP3/PRMT no-shift form is not a proven implementation;bounded layout family fails. No H200 arm or measured loss.

C.weight_copy: S19 already uses cp.async.bulk with mbarriers;adding TMA is not a new mechanism
arms: AFFINE preserves B-fill pass/valid control;one64bit base plus immediate loads
PRIVATE moves steady TMA cursor shared fields to owner registers;count residency first
